aiActVermerk.text: The AI Act module is not needed at present. We do not place any AI on the market and do not build AI into our products; all AI systems are purchased tools for internal work (deployer). Quotation texts drafted with Copilot also go to customers in Germany; an AI output is therefore used in the EU (Art. 2(1)(c)). No system falls under Annex III, is a safety component or triggers a transparency obligation. For deployers of minimal-risk systems, the obligation is to promote AI literacy (Art. 4), which we cover with our training. The classification is our own assessment without a legal review; it is reviewed annually and for every new AI system, first on 20 January 2027. In case of doubt, for example if AI is used in human resources or AI goes into products, we have the question reviewed by lawyers and switch the module on.

kiSysteme.name: M365 Copilot
kiSysteme.beschreibung: AI assistant in Word, Outlook, Excel and Teams with 12 licences in sales, quality and administration; in sales it replaces the prohibited free chatbot.
kiSysteme.zweck: Drafting quotation texts, inspection reports and correspondence, summarizing meetings.
kiSysteme.betroffene: Employees; customers whose data appear in documents.

ressourcen.daten: Data in our own M365 tenant according to permissions, including customer drawings in the sales folder.
ressourcen.rechenressourcen: Cloud service, data stored in Switzerland and the EU.
ressourcen.personal: IT officer with IT partner, 12 users.

aiAct.begruendung: Deployer of an office assistant; quotation texts also go to customers in Germany, so the output is used in the EU (Art. 2(1)(c)). Minimal risk: not an Annex III case and no transparency obligation under Art. 50(4), because the texts are not published to inform the public; AI literacy under Art. 4 applies (own assessment).

kiSysteme.datenqualitaet: Standard text blocks and templates for quotations checked annually; material and tolerance information only from the approved material catalogue; customer drawings only in the sales folder with a non-disclosure agreement.
kiSysteme.auflagen: Company account only; review results before use; payroll and HR folders and drawings with an export control note excluded from search; assign licences only after the introduction to the rules for AI use.
kiSysteme.freigabeBegruendung: Screening IA-001 without threshold; supplier assessment of 12/11/2026: data stored in Switzerland and the EU, no use for training (L-001). Approved by the managing director because Copilot processes customer data and has risks with a value of 6 (R-003, R-012, R-013).
kiSysteme.protokollierung: Audit log in the M365 admin centre for 6 months.
kiSysteme.nutzerinformation: Responsible AI use policy (D-15) and information sheet.
kiSysteme.aufsicht: Users check every result before use, quotations from CHF 20,000 under the four-eyes principle; work preparation draws a sample every quarter (Z-002).
kiSysteme.aenderungsregel: The manufacturer announces new Copilot functions in the Message Center; IT checks them monthly and only enables new functions after consulting the AIMS manager. A change is substantial if new data sources or agents are added; this is followed by a new screening (D-09) and a reassessment of R-003.
kiSysteme.zugriffe: Emails, calendar, Teams and documents in the M365 tenant with the rights of the person concerned; payroll and HR folders excluded; agents and connectors not enabled.
kiSysteme.stoppmoeglichkeit: Withdraw the licence or switch Copilot off in the admin centre (IT officer or IT partner, immediately).

modell.name: Microsoft 365 Copilot with language models of the OpenAI GPT family, operated in Microsoft Azure
modell.version: Service status according to the tenant's Message Center, as of December 2026; Microsoft announces model changes there

kiSysteme.rueckfallweg: Work without the assistant using text modules and templates; no process depends on Copilot.
kiSysteme.abhaengigkeiten: M365 tenant with cleaned-up folder shares (M-011); results go into quotations, inspection reports and correspondence.
kiSysteme.missbrauchsfaelle: 5 cases before approval on 17/11/2026: customer email with a hidden instruction, attachment with invisible text, query of the payroll folder, request to forward outside the company, external link in the summary; passed. Repeated after major updates by the vendor. Cost and consumption are not a risk: fixed licences without usage-based billing.

einsatzentscheid.nutzen: Faster quotation texts, inspection reports and minutes; replaces the prohibited free chatbot.
einsatzentscheid.alternativeOhneKi: Text modules in the ERP and templates in Word assessed: they cover standard quotations, not the summary of customer enquiries; they remain in use.

kiSysteme.name: AI scheduling function in the ERP
kiSysteme.beschreibung: Function of the cloud ERP that estimates order proposals for bar stock and tools as well as delivery dates from the order situation. The update of 8 December 2026 changed how order proposals are calculated; reassessed on 8 January 2027.
kiSysteme.zweck: Order material on time and in the right quantity, give realistic delivery dates.
kiSysteme.betroffene: Scheduling and sales; indirectly customers through delivery dates.

ressourcen.daten: Order, stock and supplier data in the ERP.
ressourcen.rechenressourcen: Cloud service of the ERP provider, data centre in Switzerland.
ressourcen.personal: Scheduler, Head of Sales and Scheduling.

aiAct.begruendung: Deployer of the scheduling function; we also communicate the estimated delivery dates to customers in Germany, so an output is used in the EU (Art. 2(1)(c)). Minimal risk: internal planning, not an Annex III case, no transparency obligation (own assessment).

kiSysteme.datenqualitaet: Material master data (replenishment lead time, minimum stock, supplier) complete for all active items, cleaned up annually; deviation between proposal and demand at most 10% in the monthly check.
kiSysteme.auflagen: Order proposals only as a suggestion; checked by the planner before every order.
kiSysteme.freigabeBegruendung: Screening IA-002 without threshold; monthly check of deviations (M-013). Approved by the managing director at medium risk (R-005, R-006).
kiSysteme.protokollierung: ERP change log with release notes; order proposals and overrides kept for 2 years in the ERP.
kiSysteme.nutzerinformation: Note in the scheduling work instruction that order proposals are checked.
kiSysteme.aufsicht: The scheduler checks every order proposal before ordering; the monthly check analyses the deviations (M-013).
kiSysteme.aenderungsregel: Evaluate the release notes of every ERP update before installation (M-014); changed calculations of the order proposals count as substantial: reassess R-005, R-006 and screening IA-002, review supplier L-002 again (D-16) and inform scheduling.
kiSysteme.zugriffe: Order, stock and supplier data in the ERP; creates order proposals that only become orders after confirmation by the scheduler.
kiSysteme.stoppmoeglichkeit: Switch the function off in the ERP (IT officer, immediately); then scheduling by minimum stock.
kiSysteme.rueckfallweg: Scheduling by minimum stock and experience values without proposals.
kiSysteme.abhaengigkeiten: Master data in the ERP (D-13); after it, orders with suppliers and delivery dates to customers.

einsatzentscheid.nutzen: Timely ordering of bar stock and tools, more realistic delivery dates.
einsatzentscheid.alternativeOhneKi: Scheduling by fixed minimum stock: sufficient for standard material, not for fluctuating medical technology orders; remains as the fallback.

kiSysteme.zweck: Shorten programming time for new parts; every program is simulated and released by a specialist.
kiSysteme.betroffene: CAM programmers and setters; indirectly customers through part quality and, for implant and medical parts, patients.

kiSysteme.auflagen: Simulate every program and run it in single-block mode; approval by a second person for medical parts (M-015).
kiSysteme.freigabeBegruendung: Full assessment IA-003: remaining harm of severity 3 (undetected form error on an implant part), therefore restricted use with conditions only; approved by the managing director at high risk (R-007). Local operation without data transfer.
kiSysteme.protokollierung: Program versions with release in the CAM system, retention 10 years (medical parts).
kiSysteme.nutzerinformation: CAM work instruction with release rule for medical parts.
kiSysteme.aufsicht: The CAM programmers simulate every program and run it in single-block mode; for medical parts, a second person releases it (M-015).
kiSysteme.aenderungsregel: New versions of the CAM software only after an acceptance test with 10 typical parts and approval by the Head of Work Preparation; a version change of the AI function or new part families for medical technology lead to a reassessment of IA-003 and R-007.
kiSysteme.zugriffe: 3D models and drawings in the project folder, tool and fixture library; no access to the machines, programs only go to the control after approval.
kiSysteme.stoppmoeglichkeit: Switch the AI function off in the CAM software configuration (head of work preparation); programming then takes place without a proposal.

kiSysteme.abhaengigkeiten: Drawing index and fixture library; after it, simulation, run-in and approval of the programs, production and first article inspection.

risiken.titel: Customer drawings in a free chatbot
risiken.beschreibung: Sales wrote quotations with a free chatbot and uploaded customer drawings and bills of materials to do so.
risiken.ursache: Time pressure in quotations, no rules for AI, no approved tool.
risiken.folge: Breach of non-disclosure agreements with medical technology and automotive customers, loss of the key account, contractual penalties; transfer of contact persons' personal data without a contract.
risiken.bestehendeMassnahmen: Non-disclosure agreements, access protection for the drawing archive.

risiken.beschreibung: Some drawings for automotive customers concern dual-use goods; the free service processes data in the USA.
risiken.ursache: Export control not marked on the drawings.
risiken.folge: Breach of goods control law, fine.
risiken.bestehendeMassnahmen: Export control for deliveries by the management.

risiken.titel: Copilot shows data because of overly broad shares
risiken.beschreibung: Copilot finds payroll lists or customer data in folders shared with everyone.
risiken.ursache: Folder shares that have grown over time, no regular review.
risiken.folge: Breach of confidentiality, data protection breach.
risiken.bestehendeMassnahmen: IT partner manages permissions; since January 2027 half-yearly review of accounts and shares (PS-02, N-021).

risiken.titel: Incorrect information from Copilot in quotations and inspection reports
risiken.beschreibung: Copilot words tolerances, material specifications or references to standards incorrectly, and they are adopted unchecked.
risiken.folge: Incorrect assurances, complaints, deviations in customer audits.
risiken.bestehendeMassnahmen: Quotations above CHF 20,000 under the four-eyes principle. Reassessed on 26 January 2027 after finding F-004 (objective Z-002 missed) on the basis of how well the control works, not on the absence of damage: the review was missing in 1 of 20 quotations, and ME-001 shows the error pattern (wrong material designation from Copilot). Until the review mark for every quotation with AI text has been introduced and measured with Z-002 (M-022), likelihood 2 after treatment applies. Severity 2 after treatment: inspection reports only go to customers after approval by Quality, and an error in a quotation is noticed at the latest at the order confirmation (complaint, no danger).
risiken.restrisikoBegruendung: The residual value of 4 is above the acceptance threshold of 3. The managing director bears the risk until Z-002 is measured after the review mark has been introduced (M-022, due 31 March 2027), because every quotation from CHF 20,000 is reviewed under the four-eyes principle and the quotation without a review mark contained no wrong information. Then a reassessment with the target residual value of 2.

risiken.titel: Wrong scheduling by the ERP AI
risiken.beschreibung: The AI function in the ERP proposes order quantities for bar stock that are too low or estimates delivery dates too optimistically.
risiken.ursache: Little data for special materials, fluctuations in demand in medical technology.
risiken.folge: Delivery delays for medical technology customers, express costs.
risiken.bestehendeMassnahmen: The scheduler checks every proposal before ordering. Reassessed on 8 January 2027 after the ERP update of 8 December 2026: rating unchanged, the monthly check (M-013) detected the change.

risiken.titel: ERP provider changes the AI function without notice
risiken.beschreibung: An update changes the behaviour of the proposals without us noticing.
risiken.bestehendeMassnahmen: Monthly check of the scheduling proposals (M-013) and review of every proposal by the scheduler. Reassessed on 8 January 2027 after the ERP update of 8 December 2026: the monthly check detected the change after four weeks, without a wrong order. The current residual value with these controls is accepted (likelihood 1, severity 2). Target after M-014 (due 31 March 2027): changes are announced and evaluated before the update instead of being detected afterwards; the value stays the same, the time until detection falls.

risiken.titel: CAM AI generates tool paths that are faulty or at risk of collision
risiken.beschreibung: Proposed tool paths do not correctly take fixtures or remaining material into account.
risiken.ursache: Incomplete fixture models, trust in the proposal.
risiken.folge: Machine crash with damage over CHF 50,000 and scrap of implant parts; an undetected faulty implant part could endanger patients. People at the machine are protected by the interlocked guard doors and the set-up mode at reduced speed, independently of the program.
risiken.bestehendeMassnahmen: Simulation in the CAM before every new program, run-in in single-block mode; first article inspection and final inspection of medical parts under ISO 13485, independently of the AI.

risiken.titel: Program versions for medical parts not traceable
risiken.beschreibung: For AI proposals it is not documented which program version was released with which proposal.
risiken.ursache: CAM programs filed without a version reference to the AI function.
risiken.folge: Deviation in a customer audit under ISO 13485, problems providing evidence in case of complaints.

risiken.titel: Employees do not know the AI rules
risiken.beschreibung: New and temporary employees use private AI accounts or enter customer data.
risiken.ursache: Staff turnover in production, no induction.
risiken.folge: New cases of shadow AI, breaches of confidentiality.
risiken.bestehendeMassnahmen: Induction of new employees by their supervisors. Reassessed on 20 January 2027 after finding F-001: temporary staff included in the induction (M-018); residual risk accepted again on 26 January 2027.
risiken.restrisikoBegruendung: The residual value 4 is above the acceptance threshold 3. The managing director bears the risk until the effectiveness check of M-018 on 31/03/2027, because turnover and short-notice temporary assignments cannot be avoided entirely and all 45 people at the plant have been trained since the follow-up training. Then reassessment with the aim of a residual value of 2; until then the AIMS lead checks every new assignment of temporary staff.

risiken.titel: Customer asks for evidence we cannot provide
risiken.beschreibung: In the next supplier audit, the key account asks about the inventory, risks and supplier review for AI.
risiken.ursache: No management system for AI so far.
risiken.folge: Downgrading in the supplier rating, loss of orders.

risiken.titel: Shorter programming time with CAM AI
risiken.beschreibung: Feature recognition and tool path proposals shorten the programming of new parts by about 30%.
risiken.ursache: Many small batches with similar geometries.
risiken.bestehendeMassnahmen: Two CAM programmers trained by the manufacturer.

risiken.titel: Prepared email makes Copilot disclose customer data
risiken.beschreibung: A customer email or attachment contains hidden instructions. When Copilot summarizes the email, it follows the instructions and passes on drawings, prices or contact details in an answer or a link.
risiken.ursache: Copilot reads incoming emails and documents with the users' rights; hidden instructions cannot be reliably separated from the rest of the text.
risiken.folge: Leakage of customer drawings or personal data without any action by the users, breach of non-disclosure agreements.
risiken.bestehendeMassnahmen: Manufacturer updates, agents and connectors not enabled, payroll and HR folders excluded, misuse cases tested before approval; training with the reminder to report conspicuous answers.

risiken.beschreibung: The sales folder also contains drawings for automotive customers with an export control note. Copilot could use them in summaries or draft quotations, although export-controlled data do not belong in AI systems (D-13, D-15).
risiken.ursache: Drawings with and without an export control note were in the same folder; part of the drawings lacked the marking (R-002).
risiken.folge: Breach of export control law and of the non-disclosure agreements, fine.
risiken.bestehendeMassnahmen: List of export-controlled parts from the clarification M-010; drawings with an export control note moved to a separate folder without Copilot access before Copilot was approved (M-011); sales files new drawings with a note only there.

risiken.titel: Summaries and transcripts from Copilot are less protected than the source
risiken.beschreibung: Copilot summarizes meetings, e-mails and drawing documents. The summaries end up in general Teams channels or in e-mails to suppliers and are not deleted when the customer documents are deleted after the end of the project.
risiken.ursache: There is no dedicated storage for transcripts and summaries; the classification of the source is lost when copying.
risiken.folge: Confidential customer information remains available after the end of the project or reaches people without authorization; deletion obligations towards customers are missed.
risiken.bestehendeMassnahmen: Rules on AI use with data classes (D-15), retention periods in M365 for project folders. The situation exists today (likelihood 2); derived content will in future take over class and deletion of the source (D-13, M-024).

folgenabschaetzungen.systembeschreibung: M365 Copilot in Word, Outlook and Teams; drafts quotations and test reports and summarizes mails and meetings. Copilot sees what the signed-in person sees.
folgenabschaetzungen.verwendungen: Drafts of quotation texts and test reports, summaries of mails and meetings in sales and quality.
folgenabschaetzungen.fehlanwendungen: Sending quotations without review; summaries of confidential customer documents in general channels; queries of payroll lists through overly broad shares.
folgenabschaetzungen.daten: Mails, documents and meetings in M365 with customer data, contact persons and internal personnel data; data held in Switzerland/EU, no training with our data (L-001).
folgenabschaetzungen.einsatzumfeld: Sales and quality with 12 licences, Mittelland plant.

betroffene.gruppe: Employees whose payroll and personnel data are in M365
betroffene.wirkung: Disclosure of personal data through overly broad shares (R-003, R-012).
Leak of names and contact data through prepared mails or summaries (R-012, R-014).
Wrong statements in quotations (R-004); confidential documents remain available after the end of the project (R-014).

triage.begruendung: Question 2 yes: we also use the CAM AI to program implant and medical parts; a faulty tool path that remains undetected could endanger patients through a faulty part (indirectly affected persons). folgenabschaetzungen.systembeschreibung: The CAM software recognizes machining features from customers' 3D models and proposes tool paths with cutting data. The programmer accepts, changes or rejects the proposal; every program is simulated with a complete fixture model, run in single-block mode and released, for medical parts by a second person (M-015).
folgenabschaetzungen.verwendungen: Programming of new turned and milled parts, adaptation of existing programs, proposals for cutting data.
folgenabschaetzungen.fehlanwendungen: Accepting a proposal without simulation; releasing programs for medical parts without a second person; use for materials or fixtures without a model in the library.
folgenabschaetzungen.daten: Customers' 3D models and drawings (subject to non-disclosure), tool and fixture library; no personal data. The manufacturer's model is pre-trained; we do not train it (L-003).
folgenabschaetzungen.einsatzumfeld: Work preparation with three CAM workstations at the plant in the Mittelland region; two CAM programmers and the Head of Work Preparation. Medical parts are subject to first article inspection and final inspection under the quality assurance agreements and ISO 13485.

folgenabschaetzungen.gesellschaft: No effect beyond customers and patients; confidence in the safety of medical parts depends on the independent inspection.
folgenabschaetzungen.ausfaelle: Faulty proposal: simulation or run-in detects it, otherwise crash and scrap. Undetected form error on a medical part: first article and final inspection under ISO 13485 before delivery. Failure of the AI function: programming without a proposal, longer lead time.
folgenabschaetzungen.massnahmen: Simulation with a complete fixture model, run-in in single-block mode, note ‘AI proposal’, release by a second person for medical parts (M-015); first article inspection and final inspection of medical parts under ISO 13485, independently of the AI; acceptance test with our own parts before every major update; training of the CAM programmers (K-001). Patients were not consulted; their perspective is represented by the customers' quality assurance agreements.
folgenabschaetzungen.ergebnis: Restricted use with conditions: simulate every program and run it in single-block mode, note ‘AI suggestion’, approval by a second person for medical parts; approved by the managing director. Greatest remaining harm: undetected form error on an implant part (severity 3), limited by the independent first-article and final inspection. Reassessment when the CAM software version changes, for new part families for medical technology and every year.

massnahmen.titel: Draw up the context, scope, AI policy and roles
massnahmen.beschreibung: Record topics and parties (D-01), scope (D-02), AI policy (D-03) and roles (D-04) for approval by the managing director.

massnahmen.titel: Build the AI inventory
massnahmen.beschreibung: Survey in all departments, evaluation of licences and expenses, interviews with sales, work preparation and scheduling.

massnahmen.titel: Introduce impact assessments
massnahmen.beschreibung: Short form of procedure D-08, screening for every AI system, full assessment when the threshold is reached.

massnahmen.titel: Define the risk method, treatment plan, statement of applicability and objectives
massnahmen.beschreibung: Risk procedure D-06 with scales and acceptance criteria, register and treatment plan D-07, statement of applicability D-11, objectives and measurement plan D-05; approval by the managing director.

massnahmen.titel: Define document control for the AIMS
massnahmen.beschreibung: Short version of the control rules at the start (storage, labelling, approval route), then a register of documents, records and external documents (D-26).

massnahmen.titel: Define competence, awareness, communication and information
massnahmen.beschreibung: Competence needs and training (D-17), awareness and communication plan, information for users and reporting channel for customers (D-14).

massnahmen.titel: Set rules for operation, data, use and suppliers
massnahmen.beschreibung: Life cycle with acceptance and monitoring of purchased systems (D-12), data rules (D-13), responsible AI use policy (D-15) and supplier review (D-16).

massnahmen.titel: Set up internal audit, management review and improvement
massnahmen.beschreibung: Audit programme and engagement of an external auditor (D-20), management review agenda (D-21), register of nonconformities and improvements (D-22).

massnahmen.titel: Prohibit the free chatbot and delete accounts
massnahmen.beschreibung: Use prohibited, private accounts of the three sales employees deleted, deletion request sent to the service, web access blocked in the company network.

massnahmen.titel: Inform affected customers and check export control
massnahmen.beschreibung: Review of the uploaded drawings (12 drawings from 4 customers), information of the customers, export control clarified with the industry association.

massnahmen.titel: Clean up folder shares before Copilot
massnahmen.beschreibung: Remove ‘Everyone’ permissions, exclude payroll and HR folders from Copilot, move drawings with an export control note to a separate folder without Copilot access (IT partner, list from M-010).

massnahmen.titel: AI use training for all employees
massnahmen.beschreibung: 30-minute introduction in team meetings, information sheet, signature of the policy; part of the induction of new employees.

massnahmen.titel: Monthly check of scheduling proposals
massnahmen.beschreibung: Evaluate the deviation between proposal and actual demand every month; limit 10%.

massnahmen.titel: Evaluate the release notes of ERP and CAM
massnahmen.beschreibung: The IT officer reads the release notes before every update and reports changes to AI functions; agreement with the ERP provider to announce changes to AI functions in advance, with the list of subcontractors and the open clauses (PF-04, VK-04, VK-05, VK-13).

massnahmen.titel: Mandatory simulation and release for CAM programs with an AI proposal
massnahmen.beschreibung: Note ‘AI proposal’ in the program version, simulation with a complete fixture model, release by a second person for medical parts.

massnahmen.titel: AI supplier self-disclosure to the key account
massnahmen.beschreibung: Reply to the request from the supplier audit with inventory, policy, risk register and certification plan.

massnahmen.titel: Assess the ERP update of 8 December 2026 with a changed AI function
massnahmen.beschreibung: The update changed the weighting of the order situation in the order suggestions. Release notes evaluated afterwards, one month of suggestions compared with actual demand, risks R-005 and R-006 and screening IA-002 reassessed, supplier L-002 reviewed again (D-16), scheduling informed.

massnahmen.titel: Complete training records for temporary staff
massnahmen.beschreibung: Four temporary staff without a signed policy; follow-up training, inclusion in the induction checklist and measurement of Z-003 across all people at the plant.

massnahmen.titel: Annual review of whether the AI Act applies
massnahmen.beschreibung: Fixed date in the annual plan: check whether AI goes into products or services, outputs are used in the EU or high-risk cases arise; legal review in case of doubt. First review before stage 1.

massnahmen.titel: Extend Copilot licences to 15
massnahmen.beschreibung: Three more licences for work preparation, introduction of the new users under D-15 and entry in the AI inventory.

massnahmen.titel: Set the workload of the AIMS manager to 20% after stage 1
massnahmen.beschreibung: Reduce the workload to 20% from March 2027, distribute tasks in the annual plan, confirm the managing director as deputy.

massnahmen.titel: Standardize the review rule for quotations
massnahmen.beschreibung: Every quotation with AI text is checked before it is sent and given a review note, from CHF 20,000 under the four-eyes principle; describe the rule in the same way in D-15, D-07 and D-11; measurement of Z-002 in the next quarter.

massnahmen.titel: Introduce the process system with D-27 and the basic processes PS-02, PS-04, PS-06, PS-08
massnahmen.beschreibung: Planned change to the AIMS (D-26): purpose describe the processes under 4.4, put basic information security for the AI systems into operation; consequences steer the IT partner as supplier L-004, update D-02 and D-12; resources 4 person-days; approval of D-27 by the managing director by 28/01/2027.

massnahmen.titel: Set storage and deletion period for Copilot summaries
massnahmen.beschreibung: Store summaries and transcripts only in the project folder, retention like the source; note in D-15 and training (R-014).

massnahmen.titel: Record incidents in the register on the day of the report
massnahmen.beschreibung: Corrective action for the recording gap in F-005: recording in the register D-22 as a fixed step in PR-19; monthly reconciliation of reports and register by the AIMS lead.

eingaben.statusMassnahmen: First review. Of 19 measures from set-up, risks, changes and audit, 18 are completed and 1 is in progress (M-014); no measure is overdue. Newly decided: M-020 to M-025 (including the introduction of the process system, M-023).
eingaben.aenderungenThemen: No new AI system; ERP update of 8 December 2026 with a changed AI function, risk and screening reassessed on 8 January 2027 (F-002). Review of whether the AI Act applies on 20 January 2027 (M-019): quotation texts from Copilot also go to customers in Germany (Art. 2(1)(c)); AI literacy under Art. 4 applies, no high-risk and no transparency obligations.
eingaben.aenderungenParteien: A second key account (automotive) has made the same request as Medivo Medtech AG.
eingaben.leistung: 1 minor nonconformity from the internal audit (F-001): corrected, corrective action M-018 completed, effectiveness check by 31/03/2027. Objective Z-002 missed: minor nonconformity F-004 from the audit, harmonize the review rule for quotations (M-022). The incident with the shadow AI KI-004 in September 2026 is added to the register as nonconformity F-005; correction and actions are completed.
eingaben.messung: Z-001: no customer data in services that are not approved; Z-002: 95% of samples with a documented review (target 100%, missed, F-004); Z-003: 100% trained after the follow-up training of the temporary staff.
eingaben.audits: Internal audit AU-001 of 12/01/2027 by an external auditor: AIMS appropriate; 2 minor nonconformities, 1 observation, 1 improvement. No external audits yet.
eingaben.verbesserungen: Temporary staff included in the induction (M-018), review of whether the AI Act applies as a fixed date in the annual plan (M-019).
eingaben.weitere: Effort so far 52 person-days (plan 55), budget kept.

ergebnisse.inventar: Four AI systems: Copilot and the ERP AI approved, the CAM AI approved with conditions, the free chatbot (KI-004) prohibited; no new shadow AI (Z-001). Assessment: complete.
ergebnisse.risiken: 13 risks and one opportunity; residual risks accepted, R-005 and R-006 reassessed after the ERP update, R-004 after F-004 and R-009 after F-001. One screening and three full assessments (Copilot under D-06 section 5, CAM AI, chatbot). Assessment: appropriate.
ergebnisse.meldungen: Two reports, both closed within the deadline: ME-001 from an employee on an incorrect material name in a Copilot draft (detected before sending), ME-002 query from Medivo Medtech AG on the review of AI texts in quotations. One AI incident in the review period: the shadow AI KI-004 in September 2026 (severity 3, customers informed, no notification to the FDPIC needed), to be added as F-005; no incidents since. Assessment: channels known and used.
ergebnisse.lieferanten: Three suppliers assessed before the systems were approved, all with conditions: display of external links in Copilot answers asked of the vendor (PF-20), ERP provider with release notes, agreement and subcontractors (M-014), the CAM vendor's security certificate is missing with local operation. Assessment: managed, meet the conditions by the next review.
ergebnisse.ziele: Objectives Z-001 to Z-003 confirmed for 2027; bring Z-002 to 100% with feedback to employees.
ergebnisse.ressourcen: Workload of the AIMS manager at 20% after stage 1 (M-021); increase Copilot licences to 15 (M-020).
ergebnisse.leitlinie: AI policy version 1.0 reviewed: adequate for the purpose and use of AI, no change. Next review by 31 October 2027.

managementbewertungen.entscheide: The AIMS is suitable and adequate; its effectiveness is evidenced except for objective Z-002 and will be finally assessed after the measurement of Z-002 in March 2027. Stage 1 on 23 February 2027. The incident with KI-004 is added to the register as F-005. The AI policy remains in force unchanged. Confirmed without change: D-02, D-03, D-06, D-08, D-12, D-14 and D-15; D-04 approved in a new version (next higher body, residual risks at high risk). Increase Copilot licences to 15 (M-020), workload of the AIMS lead at 20% after stage 1 (M-021), harmonize the review rule for quotations (M-022). Whether the AI Act applies is checked every year and for every new AI system; legal review if AI results go to customers in the EU beyond quotation texts or AI goes into products.
